value.subject: Azure updates: October 2026

body.content: This month in Azure: General availability of new regions, price changes for Blob archive tier from 1 January, and retirement of classic App Service plans in 2027. Read more on the Azure blog. You are receiving this email because you subscribed to Azure updates.
